issues.reason: The half that stands: 'genetically modified' passes the stated exposure test (predicable of the referent — 'the food is genetically modified'), so a modifier link is indeed called for; the half that falls: decomposition is defined only to single-word lemmas, so an adverb+participle modifier has no licensed genus form — the reviewer's own gap 3 — and the omission leaves nothing false or over-asserted, so no repair is licensed.

'other' has no licensed encoding (the reviewer's own gap 1), and the instruction set's standing practice for an unrepresentable modifier is to leave it out rather than mis-slot it; the bare (Through … technology) is entailed by 'other technologies' and so under-, not over-, asserts.

The witness stem must be the class — 'mint a fresh sk_<class>_<n>', and the adjective-complement rule writes it out as (Member sk_<adj>_1 <adj>) — so a state of class `focused` must be sk_focused_1, not sk_focus_1, which additionally collides with the stem a genuine `focus` event would mint.

gaps_confirmed: 'other N' as a modifier — no licensed encoding for the exclusion/contrast it marks

a gerund clause as the object of an adjective's PP complement ('focused on eliminating world hunger') — the noun-argument rule covers 'a vehicle for V-ing', not an adjective's PP taking a clausal argument
an adverb+participle modifier inside a fused compound ('genetically modified') — decomposing once to single-word lemmas cannot express a two-word modifier
adjectival-passive vs eventive-passive routing for 'is focused on' — the participle-as-modifier test is stated for prenominal modifiers, not for a copular 'is V-ed on' predicate
new_gaps: the noun-argument oblique says a clausal argument is 'reified … asserted nowhere', while the control/causative pattern reifies such a complement at TOP LEVEL with no status atom; a top-level tenseless event is indistinguishable in the KB from an asserted one, so 'asserted nowhere' has no actual encoding — here (Member sk_eliminate_1 eliminate) reads as an eliminating that exists
repair_summary: Renamed the reified state witness sk_focus_1 -> sk_focused_1 in its three atoms (class, Experiencer, On) so the stem matches its class per the sk_<class>_<n> minting convention; nothing else changed.
